description: Property transfer documents, land registry deeds, title deeds

fields.name: property_address

fields.description: Full legal name of the property owner or grantee

fields.name: grantor_name
fields.description: Previous owner who transferred the property

fields.name: parcel_area
fields.description: Size of the parcel, e.g., '0.75 acres' or '3,000 sq ft'

fields.name: registration_date
fields.description: Date the deed was officially registered

fields.name: registration_number
fields.description: Official registration or volume/folio reference number

fields.name: consideration_amount
fields.description: Purchase price or consideration paid for the property

fields.name: notary_name
fields.description: Name of the notary or land registrar who certified the deed

fields.name: witness_names
fields.description: Names of witnesses present at signing, if listed
